title: epipactis papuana
intro: Epipactis papuana, commonly known as the Papuan Helleborine, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Papua New Guinea. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, as well as the therapeutic actions of treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis papuana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
